Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Janet,I hope you're doing well too! Yes, we do offer a trial version for testing purposes. There are no restrictions on the features available in the trial version, except that we periodically remove data to ensure we provide better service for licensed studies. This means you and Dr. Hagerman can create a study, play around to configure your protocol, and confirm that everything works as expected. Later on, if you like, you can use it as your actual project and let us know to include it in your license.
